summary: Generated 18-page community documentation for Pydantic v2.13.4 (Python ecosystem) using Sourcey 3.6.3, covering 22+ API concepts including BaseModel, validators, serialization, fields, config, generics, JSON Schema, type adapter, error handling, and aliases. Deployed at umbtest03.github.io/pydantic-community-docs/ on GitHub Pages with full-text search, navigation, dark mode, OG tags, and code examples with copy buttons.
gaps: Performance benchmarks and comparison with other validation libraries
Advanced discriminated union patterns and tagged unions
Integration patterns with popular web frameworks (FastAPI, Django, Flask)
Custom validators with mode='wrap' for complex validation pipelines
Strict mode vs coercion mode detailed comparison with edge cases
Computed fields and model_computed_fields usage patterns
Persistence patterns with databases (SQLModel, Beanie, etc.)
Migration guide from v1 to v2 covering all breaking changes
Pydantic plugin system and custom types ecosystem
observations: Docs cover all major Pydantic v2 APIs including BaseModel, Field, validators, serialization, config
Each page includes runnable code examples with copy buttons
Search index enables full-text search across all pages
Sourcey navbar and sidebar provide intuitive navigation with grouping
OG tags enable rich social previews when sharing links
Same ecosystem requirement satisfied: Python ecosystem not previously documented with Sourcey on this board
